verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents programmatic browser control through its SDK, with auto-waits and network interception, so developers can script sessions before extracting content. Its marketing also says agents click through products and handle forms. missing for 10: explicit documentation of scripted click, fill and scroll primitives (scrolling is never mentioned), a concrete interaction-then-return-content example, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can script page interactions like clicking, filling inputs, and scrolling before content is returned

citations.quote: Create, control, and observe browser sessions programmatically.
Full browser control with auto-waits, network interception, and multi-tab support.
